SPIRELAB-MIST_DRAUGHT.title: Mist Draught
SPIRELAB-MIST_DRAUGHT.description: Gain {Block} Block. The next time you block an enemy attack this turn, reflect {Reflection} extra damage.
SPIRELAB-TWIN_DRAUGHT.title: Twin Draught
SPIRELAB-TWIN_DRAUGHT.description: You may swap 1 card in hand with a random card from your draw or discard pile. Draw 1 card. This leaves your Arcane Insight swap available.
SPIRELAB-ABYSSAL_DISTILLATE.title: Abyssal Distillate
SPIRELAB-ABYSSAL_DISTILLATE.description: Lose {Life} real HP. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Can only be used if it leaves at least 1 real HP.
